utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still not totally sure on the date yet, but I heard the repair drive is coming up soon. I don’t have the full list of what needs fixing either.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, that’d help — just keep me posted on the full list when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Will do — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the date and the repair list.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: The porch step first works for me — I’ll come by after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Leo — I’ll be ready by the porch step after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll see you after lunch at the porch step.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — that helps a lot. If you keep the timing and who’s bringing what clear, I think we can manage it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep the timing and who’s bringing what clear, and I’ll remind everyone to bring any tools they can spare.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — that sounds manageable. I’ll keep an eye on the timing and just check in if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, I’m here now—what’s still left to sort for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We’ve still got a few things to sort, so just bring yours over and I’ll keep it in order.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I’ll drop mine off and keep it simple. Just let me know if you need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help sort donations and hand out tools. Send me the stops when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’d be a big help, Rey — I’ll send you the stop list as soon as I have it. We’re now set for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great — Sunday at the community center works for me. I’ll be ready when you send the stop list.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive, and I’ll remind folks to bring whatever tools they can spare.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ll pass that along too since I’m still catching updates second-hand.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll keep spreading the word and remind folks to bring any tools they can spare.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can manage a little, but please keep it quiet and simple. You can come by later today.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks—what should I bring by later, and where should I leave it?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Just the basics, please—whatever you bring can be left by the front door. Thank you for helping.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got tape and spare gloves, and I can bring a couple screwdrivers too. Just tell me if you need anything else for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — that covers it for now. Really appreciate you bringing those by for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure thing — I’ll drop them by for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 10 a.m. should work well for me, and I can help keep it clear of pickup time. Once you know the date, send it over and I’ll line things up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect — I’m aiming for 10 a.m. to early afternoon, and I’ll send the date as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — just let me know as soon as the date’s locked in, and I’ll make sure it doesn’t clash with school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — please let me know if you find both the date and the repair list.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll head by after errands and check whether they’ve posted the date and repair list yet.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — I’d appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the drop-off spot and the labeled boxes for the community hall by 4—I’m a bit scattered today. If you tell me the last few stops, I’ll help keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the last stops: Elm, Pine, then the community hall. I’ll text you the drop-off spot now so the boxes can get there by 4.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Opal — send me the drop-off spot and I’ll keep an eye on the boxes. Elm, Pine, then the community hall by 4, got it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Noah — I’ve got the tools and flyers ready, and I’ll meet you at the porch step.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, thanks, Mara — I’ll be there at the porch step and help get everything started.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — I’ll bring the tools and flyers to the porch step, and we can get started there. See you soon, Noah.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure thing—I’m ready when you send the stops, and I’ll keep them organized with the drop-off spot and deadline.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Opal — I’ll send the stops over soon, and I’ll make sure the list includes the community hall drop-off and the 4 o’clock deadline.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — I’ve got the community hall drop-off and 4 o’clock deadline noted. Send the stops whenever you’re ready, and I’ll keep them organized.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check our supplies and bring the tape, spare gloves, and a couple screwdrivers by for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — that’s a big help. I’ll keep the list updated for Sunday at the community center and note that we still need screws and a few rags.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll bring the tape, gloves, and screwdrivers, and I’ll keep an eye out for any extra screws or rags too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll jot down the time and drop-off spot so it stays straight. I’d rather write it twice than forget it once.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help a lot, Oren. If we’ve got the time, place, and tools written down, I can relax a little.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely — I’ll write down the time, the drop-off place, and what tools we’re bringing so it doesn’t get scrambled.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll swing by after errands and check what else they still need.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Ira — that’d be really helpful. I’ll keep coordinating on my end so both groups know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good—I’ll check in after errands and let you know what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, I’m happy to help with all three.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, wonderful — I’ll keep asking around and let you know the date and full repair list as soon as I hear it. Folks are really stepping up, so I’m sure we’ll get the details soon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great — just let me know when you have the date, and I’ll be there to help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, for sure — I’ll keep an ear out for the date and the full repair list and let you know as soon as I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Tess — appreciate it. Just let me know when you hear the date and list.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the date and the full list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll start spreading the word on the block and ask around for extra hands and tools.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll send over the stops as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ll keep it moving and let neighbors know we need a few extra hands and tools.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — let’s meet at the community center entrance, and bring work gloves, a water bottle, and any basic tools you have. I’ll make sure both groups get the same info.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just to confirm: same community center entrance, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, same community center entrance. I’ll keep both groups posted so everyone shows up with gloves, water, and any basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’m thinking 10 a.m. to early afternoon should fit the school schedule fine. If you need, I can bring a few tools too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — I’ve got the time, but I’m still missing the date and the repair list before I can commit.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Got it — I’ll track down the date and repair list, then circle back with you. Thanks for checking!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s still on, then? We’re meeting by your front steps after lunch, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, still on—front steps after lunch. Gloves and any spare screws would be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — still on, front steps after lunch, and I’ll bring gloves and any screws I have.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll come by tomorrow afternoon to pick them up. Thanks for setting aside the wrench set and screwdriver kit.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, tomorrow afternoon works for me. I’ve got the wrench set and screwdriver kit ready for you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Oren. See you tomorrow afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll be there Saturday at 9:00 AM with my gloves. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks Eli — Saturday at 9:00 works, and the gloves will help a lot. See you then!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: You bet, Faye. I’ll be there Saturday at 9:00 AM with my gloves.
